description: List the docket entries in a federal case that have a document available, with the entry number, what the entry says, and a link to the document where the source publishes a free one. Use this when a user asks what documents are on file, whether an order or a motion is available to read, or for a copy of a filing. Availability depends on what the court source publishes; an entry with no free document is reported as such rather than guessed at. Identify the case with case_number (and court, if known), or with matter_id for a case already saved to the account. No account is needed to give a case number.

case_number.description: The case number as the court writes it, for example 1:23-cv-11195 or 2:24-cv-01234-ABC. Judge initials are optional and are ignored when matching.

court.description: The court, as a CourtListener-style code such as cacd, nysd or ilnd. Optional: leave it out when the user does not know which district the case is in.

limit.description: How many documents to return, newest first. Defaults to 20.

matter_id.description: The CaseMagic matter id, as returned by create_case_passport or shown in an earlier result. Omit it when the account follows exactly one case and that is the one meant.

name: get_case_documents
title: List available case documents
